summary: IRGC fired missiles at two commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz during Khamenei funeral ceremonies, damaging both vessels without casualties. Israeli forces eliminated multiple Hamas commanders in Gaza, including Nukhba and intelligence operatives. Syrian President al-Sharaa demanded Israeli withdrawal from southern Syria during meeting with Macron.
key_points: IRGC launched at least two missiles at commercial ships transiting Strait of Hormuz Monday evening, damaging both vessels with no casualties reported. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74857)

IDF and Shin Bet announced killing of Hamas Nukhba Force commander Ahmad Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in northern Gaza and intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daqa in southern Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/58747)
Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa told Macron that Israel must withdraw from territories it occupied in southern Syria, calling it a central Damascus demand. (Source: @pkpoi/143166)
UKMTO reported a drone strike on a tanker near Oman's coast in the Strait of Hormuz, marking another maritime incident. (Source: @inon_yttach/9298)
Israeli artillery shelled Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon, per RedLink monitoring. (Source: @redlinkleb/30479)
IDF rescued Israeli civilians who intentionally entered Qalqilya in the West Bank, emphasizing entry to Area A is prohibited. (Source: @New_security8200/202248)
Iranian informed source stated Strait of Hormuz passage follows Iranian arrangements and any US escalation will face immediate decisive response. (Source: @SharghDaily/170455)
Warplanes flew over Beirut and southern Lebanon coast at maximum alert levels, per RedLink monitoring. (Source: @redlinkleb/30407)

points: IRGC fired at least two missiles at two commercial ships in Strait of Hormuz on Monday evening during Khamenei funeral ceremonies, damaging both vessels without casualties, per Axios citing two US officials. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74857, @mamlekate/103831)

Iranian informed source declared Strait of Hormuz transit follows Iranian arrangements and warned any US escalatory action will be met with immediate and decisive Iranian response. (Source: @SharghDaily/170455)
Former Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was publicly confronted by a group chanting "dishonorable!" over his negotiations with the United States. (Source: @kianmeli1/88431)

Large funeral processions for Ayatollah Khamenei held in Tehran, Qom (100,000 attendees), and Munich (250,000 Iranians in Germany), with President Pezeshkian traveling to Najaf for burial ceremonies. (Source: @kianmeli1/88426, @presstv/197435, @SharghDaily/170454)

Prime Minister Netanyahu told CNN it is too early to predict what will happen to Iran, while stating he and Trump agree on major strategic issues. (Source: @kianmeli1/88436, @SharghDaily/170457)

sections.threat_assessment: The IRGC's missile strikes on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz during a high-profile funeral ceremony signal a calculated escalation to pressure nuclear negotiations while demonstrating maritime denial capabilities. Simultaneous Israeli decapitation strikes on Hamas's military-intelligence-training triad in Gaza indicate a systematic campaign to degrade command continuity. Syrian public demands for Israeli withdrawal from southern Syria, backed by French diplomatic presence, suggest a new diplomatic front opening. The convergence of US tanker movements, Iranian warnings of immediate response, and Israeli artillery in Lebanon creates a multi-axis flashpoint where miscalculation risk is elevated.
sections.regional_response: Turkey positions itself as mediator, with Erdogan claiming a US promise for F-35 procurement while advocating US-Iran de-escalation at NATO. Iran leverages Khamenei funeral processions across Tehran, Qom, Munich, and Najaf to project domestic resilience and transnational Shi'a solidarity. Iraq facilitates mass participation with Dhi Qar province suspending operations. France engages Syria directly via Macron-al-Sharaa meeting, endorsing territorial integrity demands. The UKMTO's active warnings reflect international maritime concern over Hormuz security.
sections.intelligence_notes: The targeting of Hamas commanders across functional divisions (Nukhba, intelligence, training) suggests Israeli intelligence has penetrated Hamas's replacement leadership pipeline. Iranian missile launches from funeral security perimeter indicate operational integration of ceremonial and military activities. The Talousa weapons discovery in a civilian bedroom corroborates patterns of Hezbollah embedding in residential areas. US tanker presence near Hormuz during Iranian missile tests implies deliberate exposure to test Iranian red lines. Netanyahu's 'too early' stance on Iran outcome reflects strategic ambiguity amid ongoing diplomacy.
